title: Gray Subway Tile Kitchen Backsplash in Mansfield
summary: Kitchen backsplash installation using gray subway tile with clean alignment around white cabinets, countertops and a decorative range hood.
problem: The kitchen needed a finished backsplash surface that would protect the wall and coordinate with the white cabinetry and darker countertops.
solution: Installed gray subway tile across the working wall and completed detailed cuts around cabinets, outlets and the range area for a clean, consistent finish.
